description: List the workspace's tags (title + id). Tags are attached with create_qr_code (`tags`) or update_qr_code (`add_tags` / `remove_tags`), and list_qr_codes searches by tag.

workspace.description: Workspace id. Optional when the account has one workspace; use list_workspaces to resolve otherwise.

name: list_tags

count.description: Total matching rows across all pages.

error.description: Present only when the tool failed (isError): cause, retryable, message.

next.description: URL of the next page, or null on the last page.
